confirm_clear: Clear completed history records? Downloaded files will be kept.
url_placeholder: Paste a YouTube video or playlist URL
analyze_hint: Paste a YouTube URL and click Analyze.
analyze_tooltip: Analyze the first URL. Add multiple links, one per line.
ready_hint: Ready — choose quality, container and save path.
playlist_ready: Playlist ready. Best source quality is resolved independently for each video.
container_override: The chosen container may not support every codec. Auto / MKV is recommended; source streams are preserved.
codec_warning: This option preserves the highest source quality. Some older media players may not support this codec.
custom_warning: Advanced feature. A custom format expression overrides the default source-quality selection.
title: Title
cookies_hint: Recommended when a video requires an authenticated session.
cookies_security: Cookies may contain login credentials. Do not share your cookies file.
proxy_hint: Leave blank for no proxy. Supports HTTP, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H.
bundled_tools: Bundled runtimes are used automatically. Advanced details show their actual paths.
debug_hint: Show technical debug messages in the log view; credentials remain redacted.
tooltip.hdr: HDR preserves the source dynamic range. No automatic SDR conversion.
tooltip.codec: The encoding used by the source; player support varies.
tooltip.container: A container holds video and audio streams. Auto follows the core recommendation.
tooltip.cookies: Use your own Netscape-format cookies.txt file. Never share it.
tooltip.proxy: Optional network proxy; credentials are masked and redacted.
tooltip.fragments: Parallel fragments per task. Higher values may be rate-limited.
about_description: Designed to preserve the original media quality provided by the source.
powered_by: Powered by yt-dlp · FFmpeg · PySide6 / Qt · QuickJS
local_privacy: No telemetry or automatic log upload. Cookies, proxy credentials and local history are not uploaded to a developer server.
rights: Only download content you have the right to save or use.
help_steps:
1. Paste a link
2. Click Analyze
3. Choose Quality and Container
4. Choose Save to
5. Click Download
welcome_description: Paste a video URL, analyze it, and choose from the media quality actually provided by the source.
error.title: Operation failed
error.analyze_hint: Analyze failed. Check Details and retry.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid video or playlist URL.
error.unavailable: This video is unavailable or access is restricted.
error.auth: Authentication is required. Configure your own cookies.txt file.
error.cookies: Unable to read browser cookies. This feature is experimental on Windows. Use a cookies.txt file instead.
error.cookie_file: Unable to read the cookies.txt file. Check its path and Netscape format.
error.proxy: Unable to connect through the proxy. Check its address and credentials.
error.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is missing. Check Runtime Health.
error.merge: Media merging failed. Open the logs for technical details.
error.format: No valid format was found. Analyze the video again.
error.network: The network request failed. Check your connection and retry.
error.challenge: YouTube rejected this request. Try again later, or configure a cookies.txt file if authentication is required.
error.403: The server rejected this media request. Retry, or configure cookies.txt if the video requires authentication.
error.cancelled: The task was cancelled. Retry to resume the download.
error.generic: The operation failed. Open the logs for technical details and retry.
active_exit: There are active downloads. Cancel them and exit?
codec_compatibility: Some older media players may not support AV1, VP9 or Opus.
download_subtitle: Paste a video or playlist URL and choose the available source quality.
queue_description: Tasks appear here when you start a download.
advanced_description: These settings are intended for experienced users.
